title: Tire Wear and Thermals ReSpin
tag_line: Tyre thermals & wear ReSpin — based on lucky4luuk (original) and Zesty_Maple98 (Redux)
message:
Tire Wear and Thermals ReSpin — an open-source continuation of tyre thermal / wear simulation for BeamNG.drive.

[B]Credits[/B]
- [USER=53119]@lucky4luuk[/USER]: original open-source Tyre Thermals and Wear mod
- [USER=393895]@Zesty_Maple98[/USER]: Tyre Wear and Thermals Redux expansion / rework

This ReSpin builds on their AGPL-licensed work. See CREDITS.md / NOTICE in the package.

[B]Features[/B]
- Multiplayer-compatible tyre thermals and wear
- Compound-aware grip from temperature, load, pressure, and surface
- Brake cooling duct sliders (saved in vehicle .pc configs)
- In-game UI apps for tyre temperatures / wear
- BeamNG 0.39-aware pack-air / draft coexistence

[B]How to use[/B]
1. Enable the mod and spawn a vehicle.
2. Add a Tyre Wear & Thermals UI app from the Apps menu.
3. Optional: open Tuning → Brakes for front/rear duct opening.
